description: Golden-run fixture for SSRAEKmeansSampling (flat, CPU-safe variant) on the micro DANINHAS dataset (2 classes, 25 train + 10 test images per class, generated by scripts/make_micro_dataset.py). Used by tests/test_golden_run.py to catch integration regressions. See .specs/architecture/refactor-plan.md Phase 2 and .specs/quality/testing-strategy.md.
git_commit_note: Regenerated 2026-08-23 for Phase 2 (refactor/phase-2-core): demo.py now routes through dalmax.cli -> dalmax.experiment.runner.ExperimentRunner, which builds SSRAEKmeansSampling via dalmax.query_strategies.registry.build_strategy -> dalmax.query_strategies.representation.RepresentationStrategy(embedding_provider=SSRAEProvider(q=13), selection=FlatKMeansClosest()). The selection's KMeans is now seeded from np.random.default_rng(dalmax.seeding.derive_seed(config.seed, 'selection')) instead of the legacy core/query_strategies/ssrae_kmeans_sampling.py's hardcoded KMeans(random_state=3) (see .specs/quality/known-issues.md KI-5, .claude/rules/reproducibility.md). round_1_query_idxs_sorted therefore legitimately changed from the Phase 1 value; see legacy_phase1_values below for the pre-Phase-2 record.

legacy_phase1_values.note: Pre-Phase-2 values (tests/golden/ssrae_kmeans_micro_seed1.json as of git commit e60ae022f77aa981cdcc9cd3b5fa6d9057151060), kept for the historical record. Produced by the legacy core/query_strategies/ssrae_kmeans_sampling.py's KMeans(n_clusters=n, random_state=3, n_init=10) -- a hardcoded literal, independent of --seed. This is exactly the reproducibility hazard .claude/rules/reproducibility.md documents and Phase 2 fixes.

notes: Phase 2 change (2026-08-23, refactor/phase-2-core): round_1_query_idxs_sorted changed from [5, 21, 37, 45, 47] to [14, 24, 37, 45, 47] because dalmax.selection.flat_kmeans_closest.FlatKMeansClosest derives its KMeans random_state from the experiment --seed (via dalmax.seeding.derive_seed(config.seed, "selection")) instead of the legacy code's hardcoded random_state=3. This is the intended fix for .specs/quality/known-issues.md KI-5 / the reproducibility.md 'Known violation to fix, not imitate' -- it is not a regression. See legacy_phase1_values above for the pre-fix values, still produced by the untouched legacy core/query_strategies/ssrae_kmeans_sampling.py class (only reachable now via utils.orchestrator.get_strategy, not via dalmax.cli/demo.py).
Verified deterministic across 3 consecutive CPU runs on the local dev notebook (no GPU) on this commit: identical initial labeled idxs, query idxs, and results.json metrics.

Initial labeled idxs are unchanged from Phase 1 and from the RandomSampling fixture (tests/golden/random_sampling_micro_seed1.json): dataset.initialize_labels's shuffle logic (utils/data.py) and dalmax.seeding.seed_everything's np.random.seed(seed) call are both unchanged for this fixture's RNG trace, independent of --strategy_name.

Uses the new dalmax.embeddings.EmbeddingCache (dalmax/embeddings/cache.py), not the Phase 1 utils/data.py::cache_file_path path: this run reads/writes results/cache/embeddings/daninhas_micro__ssrae__Q13__full__train__poola629ae2d049d.pkl (same pool_hash value, a629ae2d049d, as the Phase 1 fixture's results/cache/features_ssrae_daninhas_micro_Q13_poola629ae2d049d.pkl, since pool_hash's definition is unchanged -- dalmax.embeddings.cache.pool_hash is byte-identical to the legacy inline computation, see tests/test_embedding_cache.py). The legacy cache file is left in place, unused by this code path.

results_json metrics are identical to the Phase 1 fixture (round 0 and round 1 both 0.5/0.25/0.5/0.333): with only 1 CPU epoch on this tiny dataset, the 5 queried ids differing between the two KMeans seeds still lands on the same round-1 accuracy/precision/recall/f1 by coincidence at this scale; results.json also now carries all_precision_macro/all_recall_macro/all_f1_macro (added in this same Phase 2 batch, see .specs/architecture/refactor-plan.md Phase 2's macro-F1 acceptance criterion), which the Phase 1 fixture did not have and this test does not assert on.
